end.summary:
Reyansh practised top, front and side views of solids.
They correctly identified several views, including a ball, cone, cube and cylinder.
They explained that an object can look different from different places, with some prompting.
They first included unseen parts in a view, then corrected this using the cup-handle example.
They also solved 325 + 148 as 473.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised matching solids with their top, front and side views and used shape clues such as circles, triangles and rectangles. They explained their answers by describing what would be visible from each place. There was one mix-up about drawing parts that cannot be seen, and it was corrected later using the cup and handle example (correctAfterLastSeen: 1). At home, ask Reyansh to look at a cup or box from two positions and say which parts are visible each time.
